Name: Owl pet
Author: JorisFort
Description:
[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*]extract the .zip file
[*]place it in the mods folder
[/list]
[b]Required mods[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom music[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTk[/url]﻿
[/list]
[b]Optional mods[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (if you want to chance the color in game)
[/list]

This mod adds an owl pet to your game with sound effects.

There are 4 colors:
[list]
[*]Silver
[*]LightBrown
[*]Brown
[*]White
[/list]
You can choose you own color using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or chance the config.json file.

The default is LightBrown.
With season the c﻿olor will chance every season.


This mod was made for [url=https://www.twitch.tv/dacreid]Dacreid[/url]﻿ a twitch streamer it would mean a lot if you follow him.
